faq.q: How much does Budin Law Offices charge?
faq.a: Budin Law Offices publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Budin Law Offices offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Budin Law Offices publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does Budin Law Offices have offices?
faq.a: Budin Law Offices publishes one office, in Chicago. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Budin Law Offices?
faq.a: Budin Law Offices names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.

faq.q: Are the case results Budin Law Offices publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Budin Law Offices publishes 15 case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about Budin Law Offices?
faq.a: Budin Law Offices scores 55 and sits at Listed. Passed: footprint. Did not pass: website. Could not be answered from any public source and therefore counts neither for nor against the firm: licensure, discipline and entity registration. Every row of the scorecard above names where the value came from and when it was read. Nothing on this profile was supplied by the firm for payment, and no placement here can be bought.
